title: Freight Claim Form
subtitle: Freight Claim Intake: captures actual activity and handoff.
description: Freight Claim Form covers claimed shipment, affected goods, loss amount, supporting documents, mitigation, and investigation. The freight claims coordinator records Freight Claim Intake activity, quantities, variance, and handoff. Freight Claim Form keeps Freight Claim Intake exceptions visible until the freight claims coordinator handoff.
use_case: Use Freight Claim Form at origin, transit custody points, destination, inspection location, and evidence repository. Document claimed shipment, affected goods, loss amount, supporting documents, mitigation, and investigation identity before Freight Claim Intake begins. Compare claimed shipment, affected goods, loss amount, supporting documents, mitigation, and investigation findings with stated Freight Claim Intake criteria; route unresolved Freight Claim Intake issues to authorized claims reviewer. For Freight Claim Form, confirm requirements for Freight Claim Intake. Ask authorized claims reviewer to review Freight Claim Intake conditions beyond the freight claims coordinator's role.
